name: bp-clusterer
description: Groups enriched mentions into topics with local TF-IDF and average-linkage agglomerative clustering, then spends one model call per cluster to label and summarise it. Input is a ClusterInput, output is one application/json artifact holding a TopicSet.

skills.name: Cluster mentions into topics
skills.description: Vectorises mention text locally with TF-IDF, merges by average-linkage cosine distance to a fixed cutoff, and returns the surviving clusters as labelled topics with sentiment mix, top examples by engagement, and a trend against the prior window. Clustering itself makes no model call and no network call, so it is deterministic and free; only labelling calls a model, capped at eight clusters per window.
examples: Cluster these 300 enriched mentions for brand_id brd_01J into topics for the 24-hour window ending now.
